text:
alex: FYI hitting a new shape mismatch in the CLI sample onboarding. Node SDK (1.8.x) in json mode sometimes returns fncall output as a single-item array. Breaks the cli-sample validator.

rita: quick repro? sample name?

alex: Run `./bin/cli-sample --onboard` which calls client.call({mode:'json', function:'meta', jsonSchema: metaSchema}) against staging. Intermittent output: `[{"meta": {...}}]` instead of `{"meta": {...}}`.

noel: Is this only when retries happen? We had a similar retry+streaming edge before.

alex: Yes, much more likely when network fault injection flips a 502 mid-stream. Forcing a retry makes it trivial to reproduce.

lint-bot: :warning: samplekit lint rule json-mode-no-unchecked detected 4 occurrences in cli-sample. Add normalize helper.

rita: Python SDK doesn't reproduce in my quick test. Seems like parity problem in node retry/parse.

noel: Short term: add a tiny shim in cli-sample: `if (Array.isArray(res) && res.length === 1) res = res[0]` when schema.type==='object'. Log metric `cli.jsonmode.unwrap`.

helena: I'll open a Node SDK issue with a reproducible harness that flips 502 at token N and a unit test asserting the returned type is object, not array. Link in thread once created.

alex: Also added a small migration note to the README for cli-sample.

rita: Plan: helena to draft PR in node-sdk to normalize single-element arrays only for object schemas; no coercion for multi-element arrays. noel to add flaky e2e to our harness. alex to add the temporary shim and metric.

noel: Long-term we should standardize strict schema validation across SDKs and fail with clear errors rather than silent coercions. For now narrow safe coercion + visibility via metrics.

helena: PR opened WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/node-sdk/pull/999 (defensive normalization + tests). ETA tomorrow.

alex: Thanks team. If reviewers want access to the CLI staging runner for repro, DM me.

(ends)
